what: Waterfall keys off launcher wrapper rc instead of LAUNCHER_EXIT
scenario_or_breakage: launch-cursor-ci.sh and launch-codex-ci.sh normally exit 0 and report runtime failure through LAUNCHER_EXIT, so auth, timeout, or agent failure can be treated as tier success and never fall through to Codex or Claude
suggested_fix: Capture launcher stdout separately, parse LAUNCHER_EXIT, treat missing or nonzero LAUNCHER_EXIT as tier failure, and add tests where wrapper rc is 0 but LAUNCHER_EXIT is nonzero

what: Nonempty failure-log guard cannot distinguish useful logs from rc=3 transient output
scenario_or_breakage: gh-run-logs.sh writes a header before discovering in-progress logs, so [ -s "$gh_logs_fail_file" ] passes and sends a misleading failure log to all tiers even on rc=3
suggested_fix: Keep gh-run-logs rc in run_evaluate_failure and only build --failure-log args when rc is 0 and the capture is intended for diagnosis

what: One output path is reused across all tiers
scenario_or_breakage: Failed Cursor can leave ${output}.token-record, then successful Codex or Claude without a token sidecar causes append-token-record.sh to ingest stale token data from the failed tier
suggested_fix: Use a per-tier output basename or delete ${output}.token-record and related sidecars before each tier; assert failed-tier sidecars are not appended after later success

what: Path-list rollback cannot preserve pre-existing tracked edits
scenario_or_breakage: The proposed git restore --staged plus git checkout rollback restores paths to HEAD, so a file dirty before run_ci_fix_vendor can lose operator or prior-step edits if a failed tier touches the same path
suggested_fix: Snapshot tracked content and index state, restore to that snapshot, or fail closed when tracked dirt exists at entry; add regression coverage for pre-existing tracked and staged changes

what: Failure-log prompt injection boundary is unspecified
scenario_or_breakage: CI logs are untrusted repo-controlled text, and the plan adds them to vendor prompts without requiring an explicit untrusted-data delimiter or instruction hierarchy, allowing test output to masquerade as agent instructions
suggested_fix: Add launcher-side --failure-log handling that validates the path, caps size, wraps content in clear untrusted log delimiters, and tells the agent not to follow instructions found in logs
